title: Kunjapuri Devi Temple Rishikesh, Sunrise View & Travel Guide
content:
Kunjapuri Devi Temple - Rishikesh,

Kunjapuri Devi Temple is a holy shrine dedicated to Goddess Durga. It is one of the 52 Shakti Peethas in India and holds deep spiritual value. The temple is located at a height of 1,650 meters, about 28 km from Rishikesh.

What makes this temple special is not only its religious importance but also the amazing sunrise and sunset views. From the temple, you can see the snow-covered peaks of the Himalayas, including Gangotri, Swargarohini, and Chaukhamba. On the other side, you can see the valley of Rishikesh, Haridwar, and the Doon Valley.

Many travelers visit here early in the morning to witness the sunrise trek. The temple also becomes lively during Navratri when devotees gather for special prayers.

Best Time to Visit Kunjapuri Devi Temple:

  • Peak Season (October - March): Cool and clear weather, 8°C - 18°C. Best for sunrise and trekking.
  • Moderate Season (April - June): Warm, 18°C - 32°C. Good for temple visits, but mornings are more comfortable.
  • Low Season (July - September): Monsoon, 15°C - 25°C. The valley looks green and fresh, but roads may be slippery.

Things to Do at Kunjapuri Devi Temple:

  • Offer prayers to Goddess Durga.
  • Watch a beautiful sunrise over the Himalayas.
  • Trek through local villages and forests.
  • Enjoy panoramic views of Himalayas and Doon Valley.
  • Visit during Navratri for festive celebrations.

How to Reach Kunjapuri Devi Temple:

  • By Road: Around 28 km from Rishikesh. Taxis and jeeps are available.
  • By Trek: Popular sunrise trek from Rishikesh (about 8–9 km uphill).
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant, Dehradun (45 km).
  • By Train: Nearest railway station is Rishikesh (28 km).

Top 10 Places to Visit Nearby Kunjapuri Devi Temple (within 50 km):

1- Neelkanth Mahadev Temple (36 km): Shiva temple in the forest.

2- Ram Jhula (28 km): Suspension bridge across the Ganga.

3- Laxman Jhula (26 km): Famous hanging bridge with temples.

4- Triveni Ghat (29 km): Evening Aarti on the river.

5- Parmarth Niketan Ashram (28 km): Yoga and meditation center.

6- Beatles Ashram (29 km): Known for meditation domes and wall art.

7- Neer Garh Waterfall (26 km): Trekking and natural pools.

8- Rajaji National Park (40 km): Wildlife safari and jungle experience.

9- Har Ki Pauri, Haridwar (45 km): Sacred Ganga Aarti.

10- Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar (46 km): Hilltop Shakti Peeth with ropeway.
excerpt: Kunjapuri Devi Temple near Rishikesh is a sacred Shakti Peeth dedicated to Goddess Durga. Located high in the mountains, it is famous for its breathtaking sunrise views of the Himalayas. With its mix of spirituality and natural beauty, it is a must-visit for both pilgrims and travelers.
